name: io.github.fabioHernandezRu/edgex-foundry-mcp
title: EdgeX Foundry
description: Inspect and optionally operate EdgeX Foundry (LF Edge) via its REST API v3. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: EDGEX_METADATA_URL
environmentVariables.description: core-metadata base URL (inside a container, localhost is not the host)

environmentVariables.name: EDGEX_GATEWAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Secure-mode API gateway URL; replaces the three service URLs

environmentVariables.name: EDGEX_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: JWT bearer token for secure mode

environmentVariables.name: EDGEX_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Register write tools that can affect physical hardware
